goal: A user reports: "If a template reads an attribute of a variable and then assigns that same variable name in every branch of an if/elif/else, the variable renders empty after the block — {% if x %}{{ a.b }}{% set a = 1 %}{% elif y %}{% set a = 2 %}{% else %}{% set a = 3 %}{% endif %}{{ a }} prints nothing for the final value. Leave any one branch without the set and it works fine." Find the cause, fix it, then run the `verify` check.
